# CoffeePals

> > CoffeePals is a platform that unifies teams through automated matching for meaningful weekly coffee chats and professional connections.

CoffeePals integrates with Microsoft Teams and Slack to facilitate employee engagement, onboarding, mentorship, and cross-team networking. The platform serves organizations of all sizes with solutions for remote/hybrid work, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and internal talent development.

## Key Topics

- Employee matching
- Microsoft Teams integration
- Slack integration
- Remote and hybrid work
- Team building
- Employee engagement
- Onboarding
- Mentorship programs
- Internal networking
- Workplace culture
- Diversity and inclusion
- Cross-group connection
- HR solution
- Employee retention
- Workplace connections

## Core Solutions

- [Onboarding](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/onboarding): Matches new hires with employees for virtual coffee chats to accelerate integration and relationship building
- [Remote and Hybrid Work](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/remote-and-hybrid): Maintains team cohesion by matching remote and hybrid workers for meaningful weekly coffee conversations
- [Internal Networking](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/networking): Fosters meaningful connections and collaboration across the organization through strategic employee matching
- [Mentorship](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/mentorship): Connects mentors with mentees in Microsoft Teams to support professional development and knowledge sharing
- [Cross Group Connection](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/cross-group-connection): Links teams, departments and office locations to break down silos and encourage cross-functional relationships
- [Diversity and Inclusion](https://www.coffeepals.com/solutions/diversity-and-inclusion): Matches employees for thought-provoking conversations that strengthen inclusive workplace culture
